title: Puzzle 2D Context Menu Parity
description: Replicate puzzle3d viewport selection context menu and hierarchy tree context menu in puzzle2d, with full hidden/locked flag parity and suggest-nodes brush menu.
summary: Added hidden/locked entity flags, viewport selection context menu, hierarchy row chrome, playground wiring, and suggest-nodes parity: right-click on a free handle shows Suggest nodes (sparkles) opening an anchored brush-candidate menu via puzzle2dOpenSlotSuggestionsRef, reusing WASM brush_open_slot/brush_commit_slot/brush_cancel_slot and existing brushPlace commit pipeline.
